as_told.title: Recovered childhood memories and crisis in 2023

plain: Jordan Jose is a man who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says that in late 2022 and early 2023, some everyday events triggered him and he began to unravel. Memories from his childhood came back that he had never recalled before. He describes them as flashbacks of the kind linked to PTSD, post-traumatic stress disorder, a condition that can follow a deep shock. In another telling on the same episode, he says it all came back within about two months in 2023, and calls it a crisis: you wake up and remember a whole childhood you had forgotten. If true, it would mean children were used in such a program and their memories were hidden from them. Both tellings are Jordan's own, from one interview.
